normal.text: #TotalWarShogun2 Complete Edition on 13.10.2026: a remaster of the 2011 classic with all its expansions, DRM free on #GOG. That is how I want to buy games, as something I own and not as a licence. #AceCombat8 on 02.10.2026: the first main entry in seven years, with the campaign in first person for the first time. The battle pass annoys me, the rest does not. #RetroSpace on 01.10.2026: an #ImmersiveSim in the line of #SystemShock and #Thief, where sneaking and avoiding are full paths. That is my playstyle, ideally without a single kill. #gaming #stealth #PCGaming 3/3
